sourceRule: Root is nav with default aria-label=breadcrumb; List/Item are ol/li. BreadcrumbLink defaults to anchor through useRender. BreadcrumbPage is a nonfocusable span role=link, aria-disabled=true and aria-current=page. Separator/Ellipsis are presentation and aria-hidden; the hidden More text inside Ellipsis does not make an interactive overflow control. A real overflow menu must be explicitly composed.
keyboardAndFocus: Tab visits real ancestor links; Enter follows their href. Current page and separators are not made focusable. No root arrow navigation, roving focus or path state is implemented. Caller/router supplies updated ancestors and the current page after navigation.

protocol: SCXML consumes actual source/native transaction observations; callback objects remain original. Sends document observed callbacks, not second DOM dispatches. Parent-controlled props alone synchronize authoritative values. HTML/CSS is a semantic projection; executable behavior uses actual pinned React wrappers.

navigation.description: Actual named nav; caller can localize its label.

link.description: Actual native ancestor anchor with real destination.

page.description: Actual nonfocusable current-page span with source role=link/aria-disabled/page.

separator.description: Actual hidden presentation list item and separator glyph.

ellipsis.description: Actual hidden presentation span; no automatic overflow action.
